name: Unverified_5697
fix_description: In function 0x213d8e67, the isWhitelisted check only validates address format (address mask), not actual whitelist membership. Any valid address passes. Add proper whitelist storage mapping check: require(whitelist[msg.sender]) or require(msg.sender == owner).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step exploit involving a flash loan, AMM reserve math, and a protocol-specific abuse of UniswapV2Pair.skim via repeated token transfers to manipulate balances before swapping back. While the PoC is short, it still requires understanding pair reserve/balance mechanics and how skim can be abused, making it more than a trivial single-pattern exploit.
